# Silo Marketplace: Your One-Stop Shop for Digital Investigation Tools

[![](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/b74442ac7f64ef200ea8ee2f85639136a9b51245825c5576e7f8240b6deeb677?s=96&r=g)\\
\\
By A8 Team](https://authentic8.com/blog/author/a8team/)

July 9, 2026

![](https://authentic8.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/A8-Silo-Marketplace-BlogGraphics1-scaled.png)

Digital investigators face a common challenge: finding trusted, compatible tools that work seamlessly within secure investigation platforms. Testing, and integrating the right combination of extensions and applications while maintaining security and tradecraft standards has historically been time-consuming and complex. Silo Marketplace solves this problem.

## What Is Silo Marketplace?

Silo Marketplace is a curated in-app platform accessible directly within Silo Workspace. It provides investigators with a centralized hub to discover, evaluate, and deploy browser extensions, web applications, and native applications that enhance investigation capabilities while maintaining Silo’s security and anonymity benefits.

The marketplace features both Authentic8-created solutions and third-party integrations, all reviewed and approved for compatibility and relevance to digital investigation use cases. Accessible only within Silo Workspace, the marketplace is policy-controlled at the organization level, and all activity is captured within standard Silo logs.

## Free Tools from Authentic8

Silo Marketplace includes a suite of free browser extensions created by Authentic8 to enhance investigation workflows:

**Silo Citation** documents sources using the icz206 standard for evidence attribution. **Silo Fang** de-fangs malicious URLs for safe sharing without triggering security alerts. **Silo Referrer** enables HTTP referrer spoofing for controlled attribution. **Silo Screen Recorder** captures browser sessions for compliance and training purposes.

## Trusted Partner Solutions

The marketplace features premium solutions from leading threat intelligence and OSINT vendors. Partners include Fivecast ONYX for social media and multi-source searching, Seerist for AI-driven threat intelligence and risk forecasting, and Overwatch Data for fraud and cyber threat intelligence.

Dark web investigators can access DarkOwl for dark web monitoring and intelligence. OSINT specialists can leverage Fivecast Matrix for multi-source intelligence gathering and ShadowDragon for automated data collection, link analysis, and monitoring across social media, dark web, and over 200 public sources. Additional partners include Wirescreen for digital risk monitoring and other specialized investigation tools. Further partners will be added in the future.

## Benefits for Analysts and Administrators

For analysts, Silo Marketplace provides a one-stop shop to discover all critical Silo extensions and integrations in one place. Every application is verified by Authentic8 for compatibility and security. All solutions work directly within Silo Workspace and inherit Silo’s isolation, attribution, and anonymity protections. Investigators gain access to specialized tools for threat intelligence, OSINT, fraud investigation, and more without compromising security.

Administrators benefit from centralized discovery that helps analysts find approved tools without shadow IT risk. Access controls are available in the Admin Console, providing visibility into what solutions teams are using. Organizations can leverage Authentic8’s curation instead of evaluating every tool individually, reducing the vetting burden while maintaining security standards.

## How It Works

Discovery is simple. Access Silo Marketplace from within Silo Workspace and browse by type: Extensions, Web Applications, or Native Applications. Filter by category tags including OSINT, Threat Intelligence, Dark Web, SOCMINT, Data Leaks, Anti-Fraud, and Publicly Available Information. Search for specific solutions or explore featured offerings.

Evaluation is straightforward. Review solution descriptions, features, pricing, security details, and compatibility information. All solutions are pre-vetted by Authentic8 for compatibility and relevance to digital investigation use cases.

Deployment varies by solution type. Browser extensions install directly via handoff to the Chrome Web Store. Web applications may require account creation or evaluation licenses depending on the partner. Native applications are promoted through the marketplace with provisioning handled within the Admin Console. Standardized lead capture forms on product pages enable users to request information, trials, or purchases.

## Categories and Use Cases

Silo Marketplace organizes solutions by investigation use case. OSINT tools support open-source intelligence collection and analysis. Threat Intelligence solutions provide cyber threat and risk analysis capabilities. Dark Web tools enable safe research and monitoring of dark web forums and marketplaces.

SOCMINT solutions focus on social media intelligence gathering. Data Leaks tools help investigate compromised data. Anti-Fraud applications support fraud detection and investigation. Big Event Intelligence tools provide event monitoring and analysis. Publicly Available Information solutions assist with PAI collection and analysis.

Additional filters help investigators find exactly what they need. Browse by “No Sign Up Required” for solutions available without registration. Filter by “Free” for no-cost solutions. Select “Made by Authentic8” for first-party extensions or “Partners” for trusted third-party integrations.

## Pricing and Access

Marketplace access is free. All Authentic8-created solutions are free. Partner solution pricing varies by vendor.

Administrators control marketplace access at the organization level through the Silo Admin Console. User activity in the marketplace is captured within standard Silo logs with no separate marketplace log type required.

## Partner Opportunities

Silo Marketplace offers partners access to tens of thousands of monthly active users across hundreds of thousands of monthly unique sessions. This highly targeted audience consists of government and commercial investigators actively conducting digital investigations.

Multiple partnership models are available including referral, contract consolidation, and marketplace transactions. Organizations and partners can submit solutions via a standardized onboarding form. Authentic8 reviews all submissions, produces partner page materials, and returns a marketplace URL for partner promotion.

## Getting Started

Silo Marketplace is accessible directly within Silo Workspace. Investigators can begin exploring solutions immediately to enhance their investigation capabilities while maintaining the security, isolation, and anonymity that Silo provides.

For more information about Silo Marketplace, contact Authentic8 at +1 877-659-6535 or visit www.authentic8.com.

## Silo Marketplace FAQs

### Who can access Silo Marketplace?

Silo Marketplace is accessible exclusively within Silo Workspace. Access is policy-controlled at the organization level through the Silo Admin Console. If you’re a Silo Workspace user, contact your administrator to confirm marketplace access for your organization.

### How do I access Silo Marketplace?

Log into Silo Workspace and access the marketplace from within the platform either through the launcher or directly in the workspace.  If you don’t see marketplace access, contact your administrator to confirm it’s enabled for your organization.

### What types of tools are available in Silo Marketplace?

Solutions span categories including [OSINT](https://authentic8.com/use-cases/pai-osint/) tools, [cyber threat intelligence](https://authentic8.com/use-cases/cyber-threat-intelligence/) platforms, dark web monitoring, social media intelligence (SOCMINT), [fraud investigation](https://authentic8.com/use-cases/fraud-brand-protection/), and [publicly available information (PAI)](https://authentic8.com/use-cases/pai-osint/) collection.

### How is Silo Marketplace different from the Chrome Web Store?

While Silo Marketplace includes some Chrome extensions, it offers several key differences:

- **Approved solutions**: Every tool is reviewed by Authentic8 for compatibility with digital investigation use cases
- **Security inheritance**: All solutions work within Silo’s isolation and attribution framework
- **Investigation-focused**: Curated specifically for OSINT, threat intelligence, and digital investigation workflows
- **Multi-platform**: Includes web apps and native applications beyond browser extensions
- **Admin controls**: Organization-level access management and visibility

### How much does Silo Marketplace cost?

Marketplace access is completely free for Silo Workspace users. All Authentic8-created solutions are free. Partner solution pricing varies by vendor. Contact vendors directly through Marketplace product pages for pricing information, trials, or demos.

### Are Silo Marketplace solutions secure?

Yes. Every solution in Silo Marketplace is reviewed and approved by Authentic8 for compatibility and security. Solutions work directly within Silo Workspace and inherit Silo’s isolation, attribution, and anonymity protections. This means your investigation tradecraft remains secure, even when using third-party tools.

### Do Silo Marketplace tools compromise Silo’s anonymity?

No. All marketplace solutions operate within Silo’s security framework. Browser extensions, web applications, and integrations maintain Silo’s isolation and attribution capabilities, ensuring your investigative activities remain protected and anonymous.

### Will more solutions be added to Silo Marketplace?

Yes. Silo Marketplace is continuously expanding with new partners and solutions across OSINT, threat intelligence, dark web monitoring, and specialized investigation categories. Check the marketplace regularly for new additions.
